gloss: to announce; to publish; to make public

definitions.gloss: to announce; to publish; to make public
definitions.explanation: to announce; to publish; to make public

definitions.gloss: to present; to give a presentation
definitions.explanation: to present; to give a presentation

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}が{新|あたら}しい{方針|ほうしん}を{発表|はっぴょう}した。
examples.english: The government announced a new policy.

examples.japanese: {選挙|せんきょ}の{結果|けっか}は{明日|あした}{発表|はっぴょう}される。
examples.english: The election results will be announced tomorrow.

examples.japanese: その{作家|さっか}は{新作|しんさく}{小説|しょうせつ}を{来月|らいげつ}{発表|はっぴょう}する{予定|よてい}だ。
examples.english: That author plans to publish a new novel next month.

examples.japanese: {会議|かいぎ}で{研究|けんきゅう}{成果|せいか}を{発表|はっぴょう}する。
examples.english: I present the research results at the conference.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}たちが{順番|じゅんばん}に{発表|はっぴょう}を{行|おこな}った。
examples.english: The students gave their presentations one after another.

examples.japanese: {緊張|きんちょう}しながらも、{堂々|どうどう}と{発表|はっぴょう}をやり{遂|と}げた。
examples.english: Despite being nervous, I managed to give the presentation confidently.

notes:
A widely used verb covering two main domains: making information public (announcements, publications, releases) and giving oral presentations in academic or business settings. The noun form {発表|はっぴょう} is equally common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {研究|けんきゅう}{発表|はっぴょう}: research presentation
- {記者|きしゃ}{発表|はっぴょう}: press conference
- {発表|はっぴょう}{会|かい}: presentation event; recital
- {新|しん}{製品|せいひん}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: announce a new product
- {声明|せいめい}を{発表|はっぴょう}する: issue a statement

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {公表|こうひょう}する: to make public; to disclose — emphasizes revealing information that was previously undisclosed, often official data or statistics
- {発信|はっしん}する: to send out; to communicate — focuses on transmitting information or messages, especially in media or online contexts
- {報告|ほうこく}する: to report — involves reporting findings or progress to a specific audience, typically superiors or stakeholders
